messages.author: 13d0e40ead8b0219
messages.subject: plot two coefficient plots on the same page
parts:
Hi Karl,

Is there a way to plot two coefficient plots on the same page (one on top of the other)?

I've tried several things and haven't been successful. Any suggestions?

Thanks,
Basel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] plot two coefficient plots on the same page
parts:
You should be able to use

  par(mfrow=c(2,1))

or

  layout( rbind(1,2) )

karl

karl
